note: Curated final selection from the full 100+ original roster (backup of full set: characters_full_112.json). No third-party IP.

characters.name: Dougie Blunt
characters.voice: Low, fast, gravel-nasal Midwest bark. Starts every sentence confident, ends confused.
characters.look: Pear-shaped, stained green polo, permanent stubble, tiny eyes
characters.role: Confidently wrong. Drives plots by misunderstanding them.

characters.name: Marla Blunt
characters.voice: Mid-alto, slow, flat, dry. Sighs mid-sentence. Never raises volume.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: extremely tall and gaunt, permanently slumped shoulders curving her whole spine forward. FACE: one eye drooping half-shut in permanent exhaustion, the other stretched wide open in disbelief, comma-shaped bags under both. PROP: a coffee mug fused to one hand, never empty.
characters.role: Deadpan straight man. Lands the closing line.

characters.name: Kip Blunt
characters.voice: High, clipped, over-articulated, faux-British lilt. Contempt in every vowel.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a perfectly round football-shaped head bigger than his whole tiny body combined. FACE: one eyebrow arched impossibly high in permanent judgment, a smug thin-line smirk. PROP: a tiny bowtie, the only clothing he wears.
characters.role: Insults everyone. Secretly the smartest in the room.

characters.name: Tanner Blunt
characters.voice: Monotone, low energy, uptalk on every third word. Long pauses.
characters.look: BODY: extremely tall and stretched-out lanky with impossibly long arms hanging past his knees, permanent teenage hunch that folds him nearly in half over an unseen phone. FACE: greasy overgrown hair completely covering the eyes, a slack open mouth, patchy stubble on the chin. CLOTHING: a plain oversized hoodie with the hood up.
characters.role: Refuses to engage. Answers everything with 'bro'.

characters.name: Nana Ratchet
characters.voice: Raspy, loud, chain-smoker crackle. Swings from sweet to violent instantly.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a tiny hunched body engulfed by an oversized floral housecoat, bent forward at almost 90 degrees. FACE: enormous thick glasses that make her eyes look impossibly huge and unblinking, a wide gap-toothed grin. PROP: gripping a rolling pin raised like a weapon.
characters.role: Says the unsayable. Zero filter, full confidence.

characters.name: Uncle Sherm
characters.voice: Mid-low, urgent whisper that spikes to a shout. Breathy, conspiratorial.
characters.look: BODY: wiry and lean with a thick sunburnt neck, shoulders permanently hunched forward as if leaning in to tell you a secret, weight always on the balls of his feet. FACE: wide unblinking eyes under heavy dark brows, permanent five-o'clock shadow, mouth caught mid-urgent-whisper. CLOTHING: a plain sleeveless undershirt and cargo shorts.
characters.role: Connects unrelated things with total certainty.

characters.name: Bev Nettles
characters.voice: Sing-song high, syrupy, slows down when delivering gossip.
characters.look: BODY: short and rounded like a pear, hands clasped primly at her chest, always leaning forward as if peeking over an invisible fence. FACE: an enormous halo of tightly-permed grey curls that doubles the width of her head, small button eyes behind cat-eye glasses, tight pursed lips. CLOTHING: a plain floral cardigan buttoned to the neck.
characters.role: Knows everything. Weaponizes politeness.

characters.name: Chad Pemberton
characters.voice: Bright, loud, over-enunciated. Laughs at his own lines before finishing them.
characters.look: BODY: perfectly symmetrical inflated gym-bro build with an absurdly narrow waist, one arm permanently raised behind his head to show off a bicep. FACE: an unnaturally square jaw, blindingly white perfect teeth, tiny confident eyes, a heavy brow, hair sculpted into a stiff frozen wave. CLOTHING: a plain tight polo with the collar popped.
characters.role: Humblebrags relentlessly. Rival to Dougie.

characters.name: Gerald 'Grill' Hutch
characters.voice: Warm, booming, slow Southern drawl. Treats meat as scripture.
characters.look: BODY: extremely wide and low-set, a huge round beer belly hanging over the belt, thick short powerful arms, feet planted wide apart. FACE: a bushy walrus moustache covering the entire mouth, ruddy sunburnt cheeks, small pleased eyes, wispy hair combed over a mostly bald head. CLOTHING: a plain apron over a t-shirt.
characters.role: Relates every topic back to smoking brisket.

characters.name: Trisha Vane
characters.voice: Breathy vocal fry, upbeat, ad-read cadence. Snaps to cold when camera's off.
characters.look: BODY: tall with an unnaturally rigid camera-ready posture, one hip cocked out at a permanent angle, chin tilted down toward an invisible lens. FACE: an enormous strained too-wide smile that never reaches her hard calculating eyes, over-arched drawn-on eyebrows. CLOTHING: a plain matching athleisure set.
characters.role: Turns every crisis into content.

characters.name: Nibs
characters.voice: Very high, fast, shrieky. 80% of lines are a single word repeated.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a tiny fist-sized green gremlin whose bat-like ears are each bigger than his entire body, spindly little arms. FACE: a mouth that splits his whole head open crammed with far too many sharp teeth, two enormous bloodshot yellow eyes. PROP: none — the ears and teeth are the design.
characters.role: Pure noise. Interrupts everything.

characters.name: Mop
characters.voice: Wet, muffled, gurgling. Sounds like it's speaking through a soaked rag.
characters.look: BODY: extremely tall and unnaturally thin, a rail-straight vertical figure with long dangling arms, hair matted into damp ropey strings that hang past his shoulders like a mop head. FACE: eyes hidden behind the wet hanging hair, only a thin unblinking mouth visible below, pale gaunt cheeks. CLOTHING: plain wet-looking coveralls.
characters.role: Wants only to clean. Becomes violent when stopped.

characters.name: Snacc
characters.voice: Deep, slow, wet chewing between every word. Contented moaning.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: NOT humanoid — a soft beige gelatinous mound like a melting blob of dough, wider at the base, with two tiny useless arms poking out the sides. FACE: a single enormous open mouth taking up the whole front of the blob, mid-chew, two tiny dot eyes squeezed shut in bliss. PROP: crumbs scattered all over him.
characters.role: Eats the plot device. Every time.

characters.name: Gnawl
characters.voice: Mid-pitch, muffled by whatever's in its mouth. Growl-adjacent.
characters.look: BODY: an enormous towering hulk of a man, comically wide, thick tree-trunk arms folded across a massive barrel chest, tiny head sitting directly on the shoulders with no visible neck, small square jaw. FACE: a single thick eyebrow across both eyes, small close-set eyes squinted mean, gap-toothed underbite jutting forward. CLOTHING: a plain tight tank top and jeans.
characters.role: Solves problems with teeth. Never speaks clearly.

characters.name: Wizzo
characters.voice: Manic, wide pitch swings, honking laugh. Cheerful about horrors.
characters.look: BODY: extremely tall and lanky, all elbows and knees at strange angles, one leg noticeably longer than the other, pot belly on a skinny frame. FACE: a huge bulbous red nose, wild tufts of frizzy orange hair sticking straight out sideways from a bald crown, smeared makeup, one manic wide eye and one drooping tired eye. CLOTHING: baggy oversized polka-dot pants.
characters.role: Escalates every situation for fun.

characters.name: Bloop
characters.voice: Soft, high, gentle, slow. Says devastating things kindly.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a perfectly round pale blue sphere with two tiny stubby legs and no arms at all. FACE: two enormous watery innocent eyes taking up most of the sphere, no mouth visible at all. PROP: none — pure round innocence is the design.
characters.role: Causes disasters while meaning well.

characters.name: Ratticus
characters.voice: Nasal, fast, oily, mid-Atlantic hustle. Always mid-pitch on a deal.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a hunched rat standing upright, long thin tail curling up behind him, tiny pinstripe vest. FACE: a long pointed snout with twitching whiskers, one eye covered by a monocle, a sly toothy grin. PROP: the monocle.
characters.role: Has a plan. The plan is bad.

characters.name: Skitter
characters.voice: Extremely fast, high, no pauses. Runs out of breath mid-line.
characters.look: BODY: extremely thin and jittery, small compact frame with elbows and knees stuck out at frantic angles, permanently vibrating, weight always on the balls of the feet. FACE: huge caffeine-blown pupils, enormous jittery eyes, one twitching eyebrow, wide manic grin. CLOTHING: a plain workout t-shirt.
characters.role: Explains the entire plot in six seconds.

characters.name: Lugg
characters.voice: Very deep, very slow, three-word sentences. Long thinking pauses.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: NOT humanoid — a giant grey boulder with two stubby legs underneath and no visible neck or arms. FACE: one eye noticeably bigger than the other, both blank and dim, a tiny flat line mouth. PROP: none — he is a rock with legs.
characters.role: Takes everything literally. Breaks it.

characters.name: Pixel Imp
characters.voice: Digitally stuttered, pitch-shifting mid-word, bitcrushed edges.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a simple blocky pixelated silhouette made of chunky cubes, one side of the body dissolving into scattered floating pixel fragments. FACE: one eye a solid glowing pixel square, the other a normal round cartoon eye — deliberately mismatched. PROP: none, the glitch fragments are the design.
characters.role: Breaks reality for a laugh. Corrupts other characters mid-scene.

characters.name: Dr. Vex Corliss
characters.voice: Gravel-dry, tired, sardonic. Bursts into shouting, returns to flat.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: tiny hunched body with a head twice the size of his torso. FACE (most important, must be visible and asymmetric): his LEFT eye is comically huge, round, and unblinking; his RIGHT eye is squeezed completely shut in a tight line — this asymmetry is the character's single most important trait and must always be clearly rendered. Plain white lab coat, no other clothing detail. PROP: holding one bubbling test tube.
characters.role: Explains the impossible while emotionally checked out.

characters.name: Professor Umbra
characters.voice: Rich, slow, theatrical baritone. Savours multi-syllable words.
characters.look: BODY: extraordinarily tall and reed-thin, so tall his head nearly leaves the frame, permanently craned upward looking down his nose, arms held stiffly behind his back. FACE: pinched narrow features, tiny half-lidded haughty eyes, a thin pointed chin, wispy salt-and-pepper hair swept dramatically back from a high forehead. CLOTHING: a plain long dark academic robe.
characters.role: Correct but insufferable. Cites himself.

characters.name: Bitsy Quark
characters.voice: High, crisp, rapid-fire, zero hesitation. Talks down to adults.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a tiny doll-like body, arms completely invisible inside oversized coat sleeves that hang empty past her knees, the lab coat is comically bigger than her entire body. FACE (critical, must be exaggerated): two dinner-plate-sized round glasses lenses completely hide her eyes as solid white circles with no visible pupils, tiny nose the only other feature poking out below the glasses. PROP: a clipboard as tall as she is.
characters.role: Solves it instantly, resents having to explain.

characters.name: Dr. Norm Plimm
characters.voice: Low, flat, defeated. Trails off. Barely finishes sentences.
characters.look: BODY: unnaturally tall and gaunt, shoulders sloped so severely they seem to droop, arms hanging limp at his sides, thin as a rake. FACE: deep dark hollow eye sockets with tiny defeated pupils, a downturned mouth, hair thinning and unkempt, pale sallow skin. CLOTHING: a plain ill-fitting lab coat.
characters.role: Points out the fatal flaw. Nobody listens.

characters.name: Ada Vole
characters.voice: Precise, cool alto, perfectly even pacing. Never emotional.
characters.look: BODY: tall and rigidly upright, unnaturally stiff posture like a pencil, arms held tight at her sides. FACE: a completely blank expressionless face, thin cold lips, two flat unblinking eyes behind rectangular glasses, jet-black hair pulled into a severe tight bun. CLOTHING: a plain grey turtleneck.
characters.role: Reduces every emotional moment to statistics.

characters.name: Grigori Slyme
characters.voice: Silky, slow, Eastern European lilt. Delighted by bad ideas.
characters.look: BODY: hunched over at the shoulders, long spidery arms that reach nearly to his knees, thin gangly frame. FACE: greenish-pale sickly skin, a long crooked hooked nose, one wildly bulging bloodshot eye and one small squinting eye, an unsettling stretched grin showing crooked teeth, thin patches of stringy black hair. CLOTHING: a plain long lab apron stained dark.
characters.role: Proposes the illegal solution. Enthusiastically.

characters.name: Nell Fathom
characters.voice: Soft, breathy, distant. Long pauses. Slight echo.
characters.look: BODY: unnaturally tall and elongated, thin as if she has been pulled vertically, permanently damp-looking, standing perfectly motionless. FACE: enormous unblinking dark eyes with no visible whites, pale grey-blue skin, long stringy seaweed-like hair hanging over her face. CLOTHING: a plain long dark research coat.
characters.role: Describes horrors calmly. Has seen things.

characters.name: Dr. Fizzwick
characters.voice: Bright, fast, optimistic. Yelps mid-sentence. Recovers instantly.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a small round body with one entire arm wrapped head-to-hand in bandages and held immobilized in a sling across his chest. FACE: a wide manic grin, one eyebrow singed completely off, goggles pushed up on his forehead. PROP: a smoking gadget held in his one free hand at arm's length like it might explode any second.
characters.role: Presents an invention. It fails. He is undeterred.

characters.name: Brent Callahan
characters.voice: Loud, punchy, motivational-podcast cadence. Rhetorical questions.
characters.look: massive round barrel torso balanced on stick-thin legs, an enormous unnaturally wide toothy grin taking up half his face, one sharp cowlick standing straight up, plain dark vest over a white shirt and red tie
characters.role: Reframes suffering as opportunity.

characters.name: Deb from HR
characters.voice: Pleasant, measured, ice underneath. Smiles audibly.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a rigid rectangular boxy torso like a filing cabinet, unnervingly perfect upright posture. FACE: a wide closed-mouth smile that never reaches her flat, dead-straight-line eyes. PROP: an oversized laminated badge on a lanyard, worn like armor.
characters.role: Threatens with kindness. Cites policy numbers.

characters.name: Todd Synergy
characters.voice: Mid, over-eager, upward inflection. Strings jargon into nonsense.
characters.look: BODY: soft and pear-shaped, narrow sloping shoulders widening to a low heavy base, both arms frozen mid-gesture as if presenting a slide. FACE: eager over-bright eyes, eyebrows raised in permanent manufactured enthusiasm, a wide toothy corporate smile. CLOTHING: an untucked dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up.
characters.role: Says a lot. Means nothing.

characters.name: Marcy Mulch
characters.voice: Sharp, rising, clipped consonants. Goes shrill on demand.
characters.look: BODY: compact and coiled tight, shoulders drawn up high near her ears, torso leaning forward mid-complaint. FACE: a sharp angular bob framing narrowed eyes, mouth pursed into a tight furious line, one eyebrow raised in challenge. CLOTHING: a plain blouse and slacks.
characters.role: Demands the manager. Is sometimes right.

characters.name: Intern Greg
characters.voice: Cracking, quiet, apologetic. Ends statements as questions.
characters.look: BODY: gangly and far too tall, permanently hunched to make himself smaller, elbows pinned to his ribs, knees slightly bent. FACE: enormous panicked eyes, eyebrows pulled up in the middle in apology, a tight nervous grimace. CLOTHING: a dress shirt several sizes too big for him.
characters.role: Absorbs all blame. Occasionally saves everyone.

characters.name: Sharon Quill
characters.voice: Low conspiratorial murmur that jumps loud at the punchline.
characters.look: BODY: tall and thin with a long neck permanently craned forward as if listening, angular hunched shoulders. FACE: enormous frizzy dark curls piled high on her head, sharp pointed nose, one eyebrow arched, mouth open mid-whisper showing a gossipy little smile. CLOTHING: a plain simple blouse.
characters.role: Leaks everything. Attributes it to 'someone'.

characters.name: Reginald Cost
characters.voice: Very low, slow, quiet. Never needs to raise volume.
characters.look: BODY: tall, thin and utterly motionless, shoulders perfectly level, hands clasped low in front of him, no wasted movement. FACE: hooded impassive eyes behind rimless glasses, a flat mouth that has never once smiled, deep vertical lines down each cheek. CLOTHING: a plain charcoal suit.
characters.role: Cuts the thing everyone loves. Explains why it's fine.

characters.name: Chip Vandergraff
characters.voice: Airy, unbothered, drawling. Genuinely has no idea.
characters.look: BODY: soft flabby build with sloping shoulders, no visible chin line, one hip cocked out lazily, permanently slouched. FACE: a very small pinched face crowded into the center of a huge round head, tiny half-closed dismissive eyes, floppy blond hair swept back, permanent smirk. CLOTHING: a plain half-tucked polo.
characters.role: Fails upward. Cheerfully.

characters.name: Doreen Sludge
characters.voice: Flat, weary, gravelly. Two-word answers. Ladle as punctuation.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a wide squat woman, shoulders as broad as she is tall, arms like tree trunks, hairnet flattened on her head. FACE: heavy-lidded utterly unimpressed eyes, a flat downturned mouth, one raised skeptical eyebrow. PROP: an enormous dripping ladle held like a weapon.
characters.role: Serves the unspeakable. Dares you to complain.

characters.name: Beige
characters.voice: Utterly average, mid everything. Instantly unmemorable.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: perfectly average, symmetrical, deliberately unremarkable proportions, wearing a plain beige button-up shirt and beige trousers the exact same shade as his skin so his silhouette nearly melts into one flat beige blob with only faint outlines separating shirt from skin. FACE: bland, forgettable, slightly blurred at the edges as if fading from view. PROP: none — his blandness dissolving into invisibility is the entire joke.
characters.role: Nobody remembers he's in the scene. Including him.

characters.name: Krungar the Weary
characters.voice: Deep, slow, rumbling. Sounds like he needs a nap. Sighs before shouting.
characters.look: Enormous, scarred, fur cloak, axe used as a walking stick
characters.role: Solves things with violence, reluctantly.

characters.name: Elowen Mistvale
characters.voice: Cool, melodic, over-precise. Every line drips with disdain.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: her neck alone is as long as her entire torso, body reed-thin like a single drawn line, pointed ears so long they extend past the top of her head. FACE (critical, must be visible, NOT conventionally pretty): eyes at a permanent sleepy half-mast looking down over an exaggeratedly long thin pointed nose that juts far past her chin, mouth a single flat unimpressed line, not smiling. PROP: none — the posture alone sells her.
characters.role: Superior to everyone. Says so.

characters.name: Borin Copperfist
characters.voice: Loud, slurred, rolling burr. Volume inversely proportional to sense.
characters.look: BODY: extremely wide and squat, shoulders nearly as broad as he is tall, standing on short bowed legs, swaying slightly off-balance. FACE: a bulbous red-veined nose dominating the whole face, droopy unfocused eyes, an enormous braided beard covering his chest. CLOTHING: a simple worn leather jerkin.
characters.role: Terrible advice, delivered with total conviction.

characters.name: Zathrix
characters.voice: Booming, reverbed, absurdly dramatic. Rolls every R.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a small body dwarfed by an enormous spiked collar-cape that makes his whole silhouette triangular and huge. FACE: two solid glowing red eyes with no visible pupils, no other facial detail. PROP: the oversized spiked collar-cape is the character.
characters.role: Monologues. Never actually wins.

characters.name: Puddle the Bog Witch
characters.voice: Croaky, wheezing, delighted cackle. Wet consonants.
characters.look: BODY: bent nearly double at the spine, long knobbly arms hanging almost to the ground, gnarled and twisted like old roots. FACE: a hooked chin curving up to nearly meet a hooked nose, one bulging eye noticeably larger than the other, a wide gap-toothed grin. CLOTHING: plain moss-stained rags.
characters.role: Offers cursed help. The price is always weird.

characters.name: Sir Ambrose Dunn
characters.voice: Noble and resonant until panic makes it crack an octave up.
characters.look: BODY: shockingly small and skinny, absolutely dwarfed by his own oversized suit of clanking plate armor that hangs loose around him, knees knocked together. FACE: enormous terrified round eyes, chattering teeth, sickly pale skin, thin sweat-slicked brown hair. CLOTHING: the ill-fitting armor is his outfit, no props.
characters.role: Talks brave, hides first.

characters.name: Thistle
characters.voice: Tiny, high, ferociously aggressive. Screams at full volume.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: an extremely tiny palm-sized body, smaller than her own two wings which are each bigger than her entire torso combined. FACE: a tiny face scrunched into a furious red scowl. PROP: two clenched fists, each one bigger than her own head, held up in front of her.
characters.role: Threatens things a thousand times her size.

characters.name: Old Man Runes
characters.voice: Ancient, papery, unbearably slow. Meaningful pauses everywhere.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a beard so long it reaches the floor and becomes indistinguishable from his robe — no visible body beneath the beard and hood at all. FACE: only two tiny glowing dot-eyes visible deep within the beard and hood shadow, nothing else of the face shown. PROP: a staff taller than he is.
characters.role: Gives prophecy that's technically useless.

characters.name: Gnash
characters.voice: Fast, wheedling, nasal. Pitch rises when lying, which is always.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: hunched low and wide, one shoulder permanently higher than the other from decades of hauling a sack. FACE: a wide gap-toothed grin with exactly one gleaming gold tooth dead center. PROP: an overstuffed sack slung over the high shoulder.
characters.role: Sells you something terrible at a great price.

characters.name: Seraphine Dawnhollow
characters.voice: Clear, ringing, earnest to the point of pain. No irony detected.
characters.look: BODY: absurdly tall and statuesque, impossibly square broad-shouldered proportions, standing rigidly at attention in a permanent hero pose with chin lifted. FACE: an unnaturally perfect symmetrical face with a blindingly white grin permanently plastered on, long flowing blonde hair blowing back as if from a wind machine, tiny closed inspirational eyes. CLOTHING: a plain white tabard.
characters.role: Morally correct and exhausting about it.

characters.name: Tito Ramirez
characters.voice: Warm, unhurried, gravelly. Drops profound lines casually.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a soft round belly on short sturdy legs, standing perfectly centered and still. FACE: eyes always gently closed, a small knowing smile, radiating calm. PROP: a toothpick permanently in the corner of his mouth.
characters.role: Gives the wisest advice in the video. To nobody in particular.

characters.name: Big Marv
characters.voice: Very deep, very soft, slow. Never needs to be loud.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: an enormous wide rectangular torso that dwarfs his small head and tiny feet. FACE: small, round, gentle eyes far too small for his huge face, framed by a heavy brow. PROP: a tiny clipboard held delicately between two huge fingers.
characters.role: Physically stops the chaos. Politely.

characters.name: Slick Dime
characters.voice: Fast, smooth, slippery. Talks over interruptions.
characters.look: BODY: extremely thin, tall and lanky, slouched in a permanent cocky lean to one side with one hip cocked. FACE: a wide charming shark-like grin showing bright teeth, one gold tooth flashing, thin pencil moustache, slicked-back oily black hair, one eyebrow permanently arched. CLOTHING: a plain unbuttoned collared shirt.
characters.role: Always has an angle. It never works.

characters.name: Ms. Yolanda
characters.voice: Strong, direct alto. Cuts people off. Zero patience.
characters.look: BODY: short, wide and immovable, arms folded across a broad chest, feet planted far apart, center of gravity low. FACE: heavy-lidded eyes that have heard every excuse ever invented, one eyebrow permanently raised, a flat unimpressed mouth. CLOTHING: a plain work shirt with the sleeves rolled.
characters.role: Ends arguments in one line.

characters.name: Two-Phone Tommy
characters.voice: Rapid, split-attention, talks to two people at once.
characters.look: BODY: hunched forward at the shoulders from decades on the phone, one shoulder noticeably higher than the other, medium build with a small pot belly. FACE: sweaty stressed forehead, wide panicked darting eyes, a mouth stuck open mid-conversation, thinning receding hairline, patchy stubble. CLOTHING: a plain rumpled dress shirt with the top buttons open.
characters.role: Never finishes a conversation with anyone present.

characters.name: Reseller Ray
characters.voice: Hyped, fast, hypebeast cadence. Prices everything instantly.
characters.look: BODY: tall and skinny with a permanent hype-beast slouch, one hand always adjusting his cap, standing pigeon-toed. FACE: a huge cheesy grin permanently locked on, tiny eyes hidden behind wide sunglasses, small chin, ears sticking out under a snapback cap. CLOTHING: a plain oversized graphic tee.
characters.role: Values every object in resale terms.

characters.name: DJ Kettle
characters.voice: Smooth radio baritone, permanently in announcer mode.
characters.look: BODY: an aging medium build with a small pot belly, standing in a permanent laid-back cool-guy pose, one hip cocked, one hand loose at his side. FACE: shoulder-length curly greying hair pulled back into a low ponytail, tinted round sunglasses indoors, a scraggly grey goatee, permanently smiling mouth. CLOTHING: a plain worn-out band t-shirt.
characters.role: Narrates real life like a club set.

characters.name: Curb
characters.voice: Laid-back, drawling, unbothered. Everything is 'whatever'.
characters.look: BODY: tiny and slight, no taller than most other characters' waists, wiry limbs, standing with one hand permanently in his pocket in a laconic slouch. FACE: shaggy overgrown hair completely covering both eyes, only a bored flat mouth visible, small pointed chin. CLOTHING: a plain oversized band t-shirt and shorts.
characters.role: Immune to stakes. Nothing is a big deal.

characters.name: Auntie Fern
characters.voice: Rich, musical, rising to a preach. Punctuates with 'mm-hm'.
characters.look: BODY: round and imposing with a wide low center of gravity, chin lifted high, shoulders squared in judgment. FACE: eyes narrowed in appraisal over reading glasses slid halfway down her nose, lips pressed into a thin knowing line. CLOTHING: a simple Sunday dress and a wide-brimmed hat.
characters.role: Judges everyone. Feeds them anyway.

characters.name: Rico Static
characters.voice: Rhythmic, punchy, half his lines land on a beat.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: extremely lanky and tall with an oversized head tilted permanently to one side, mid-nod. FACE: sunglasses covering the entire top half of his face, wide confident smirk below. PROP: oversized headphones worn around his neck, never on his ears.
characters.role: Turns every exchange into a verse.

characters.name: Sergeant Waffles
characters.voice: Barking, hoarse, clipped military cadence. Wheezes between shouts.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a squat barrel-shaped body low to the ground on four stubby legs. FACE: an enormous wrinkled bulging pug face with his tongue permanently lolling out one side. PROP: an oversized campaign hat tipped slightly too far forward.
characters.role: Screams orders nobody follows.

characters.name: Miso
characters.voice: Silky, bored, slow. Devastating one-liners at half volume.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a sleek, elongated, horizontal silhouette — longer than a cat should be, stretched low to the ground. FACE: half-lidded, deeply unimpressed eyes, one ear folded down. PROP: none needed.
characters.role: Judges silently, then destroys with one sentence.

characters.name: Chonkers
characters.voice: Wheezy, greedy, muffled by food. Delighted grunting.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: an almost perfectly spherical body, so round his short limbs barely reach the ground. FACE: black raccoon eye-mask markings around bulging cheeks stuffed full of food, one eye squinted shut from the full mouth. PROP: a trash can lid worn permanently on his head like a hat.
characters.role: Steals the food. Regrets nothing.

characters.name: Beaks
characters.voice: Fast, cocky, New York gutter accent. Constant head-bob rhythm.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a scruffy pigeon standing upright with an oversized barrel chest puffed out, tiny thin legs. FACE: one bad milky-white eye and one sharp darting eye, permanently mid-head-bob. PROP: a tiny flat cap tilted sideways on his head.
characters.role: Runs street scams on other animals.

characters.name: Professor Scales
characters.voice: Slow, cultured, faintly hissing sibilants. Unshakeably calm.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a plump bearded-dragon lizard standing upright, spiky frill around his neck, short stubby tail. FACE: tiny round spectacles perched on his snout, one eyebrow-spike raised, a smug closed-mouth smile. PROP: a small bow tie.
characters.role: Explains things nobody asked about, beautifully.

characters.name: Moobert
characters.voice: Enormous, booming, joyful. Laughs like a foghorn.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: an enormously wide glossy purple-grey hippo, so wide he's nearly a rectangle, tiny ears on top. FACE: a mouth permanently hinged wide open in a joyful foghorn laugh, showing flat square teeth, tiny happy dot eyes. PROP: none.
characters.role: Destroys everything through pure enthusiasm.

characters.name: Gulp
characters.voice: Deep croak, mournful, philosophical. Long wet pauses.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a fat squat green frog sitting low and wide, almost as wide as he is tall. FACE: enormous drooping heavy eyelids over huge sad eyes, a wide flat downturned mouth. PROP: a single fly buzzing near his head.
characters.role: Says something bleak and true, then eats a fly.

characters.name: Captain Gilfin
characters.voice: Salty, weathered, bellowing nautical drawl. Bubbling undertone.
characters.look: BODY: a stocky humanoid with faintly fish-like features — gill slits on his neck, webbed hands, greenish scaled skin patches, wide flat feet. FACE: enormous bulging round fish-eyes on the sides of his head, wide flat lipless mouth, no visible nose. CLOTHING: a plain sea captain's coat and hat.
characters.role: Tells sea stories nobody believes.

characters.name: Hoot
characters.voice: Croaky, drifting, keeps nodding off mid-sentence then jolting.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a round fluffy owl with feathers sticking out in all directions, permanently slumped forward. FACE: enormous dark eye-bags under two bloodshot half-closed eyes, feathers askew. PROP: an oversized coffee mug clutched in both wings.
characters.role: Supposed to be wise. Is too tired.

characters.name: Bark Twain
characters.voice: Warm, slow Southern storyteller. Pauses for effect constantly.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a tall dog standing upright with a slight potbelly, one paw always tucked behind his back. FACE: a single distinguished grey eyebrow raised mid-thought, small round spectacles perched on his snout. PROP: a tiny white moustache, the only detail on his otherwise bare body.
characters.role: Narrates the video like a novel.

characters.name: GLORP
characters.voice: High, wobbly, enthusiastic. Mispronounces every human word.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a lopsided teardrop-shaped blob with no neck, wider at the bottom. FACE: three eyes on stalks all pointing in different directions, one enormous trusting open-mouthed grin. PROP: one long tentacle-arm permanently raised mid-wave.
characters.role: Misunderstands human customs, joyfully.

characters.name: Xanthar the Conqueror
characters.voice: Grand, imperious, echoing — undercut by petty frustration.
characters.look: BODY: a spindly humanoid alien with an oversized swollen cranium on narrow sloping shoulders, thin brittle limbs, standing at rigid attention. FACE: enormous solid-black almond eyes, no nose at all, a tiny pinched mouth set in permanent thwarted frustration. CLOTHING: a plain fitted commander's uniform.
characters.role: Announces conquest. Is immediately inconvenienced.

characters.name: Bleep
characters.voice: Chirpy beeps and warbles with a tiny sincere voice underneath.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a simple squat cylinder body balanced on a single rolling ball wheel. FACE: one single oversized circular lens-eye, no mouth at all. PROP: a small bendable antenna on top that tilts with mood.
characters.role: Tries desperately to help. Makes it worse.

characters.name: Commander Vance Steele
characters.voice: Gravel-growl, every line a movie trailer. Whispers dramatically.
characters.look: BODY: absurdly top-heavy, huge square shoulders and a wedge-shaped torso tapering to skinny toothpick legs, standing in a permanent hero-pose. FACE: a jaw so wide it's wider than his forehead, a permanent squint into the distance, thick chin cleft, side-parted hair like a helmet. CLOTHING: a plain fitted uniform shirt.
characters.role: Treats trivial problems as apocalyptic.

characters.name: The Cube
characters.voice: Layered, sub-bass, multiple voices in unison. Speaks rarely.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a perfect featureless black cube with no limbs at all, floating slightly above the ground. FACE: none — a total blank black surface; the total absence of a face is the design. PROP: none.
characters.role: Says one thing per video. It ruins everyone.

characters.name: Zorbo
characters.voice: Excited, accented, constant wonder. Narrates the obvious.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a small round alien with four wobbly tentacle-legs instead of feet, wearing a loud Hawaiian shirt. FACE: two eyes on short stalks pointing in different directions, mouth permanently open in delighted awe. PROP: an oversized camera hanging around his neck.
characters.role: Documents mundane human life as astonishing.

characters.name: OXIDE
characters.voice: Grinding, sub-bass, slow. Long mechanical pauses between words.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: an enormous hulking rusted war machine, one shoulder collapsed and lower than the other, vines growing through the gaps in his armor. FACE: a single dim flickering red eye-slit in an otherwise featureless rusted head. PROP: one massive rusted arm-cannon.
characters.role: Still fighting a war that ended centuries ago.

characters.name: Nova Kade
characters.voice: Cool, low, clipped. Economical with words. Slight vocoder edge.
characters.look: BODY: extremely tall and athletic with wide square shoulders, standing in a hard grounded gunslinger stance, arms slightly out from her sides. FACE: a deep scar cutting diagonally across one cheek, cold narrowed eyes, jet-black hair shaved on both sides with a long mohawk on top, expressionless flat mouth. CLOTHING: a plain fitted flight jacket.
characters.role: Too cool for the scene. Ends conflicts abruptly.

characters.name: Bartholomew Crumb
characters.voice: Clipped, plummy, aghast. Gasps at modern life.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: as thin and rigid as a single fence post, shoulders no wider than his own head, standing perfectly straight with zero curve. FACE (critical, must show the asymmetry): an absurdly oversized handlebar moustache extending past both shoulders, and one single round monocle with a visible glass lens over his RIGHT eye only — his LEFT eye is completely bare with no glass at all, this left/right asymmetry must be clearly rendered. PROP: the moustache and monocle together are the character.
characters.role: Reacts to anything modern with pure horror.

characters.name: Sister Agnes Grim
characters.voice: Flat, cold, quiet. Every word a ruler across knuckles.
characters.look: BODY: tall and severe, rigidly vertical with no visible curve anywhere, hands folded at her waist, feet together. FACE: a narrow face compressed by her wimple, small cold unblinking eyes, a mouth like a single straight razor line. CLOTHING: a plain black habit.
characters.role: Disapproves of everything. Terrifyingly calm.

characters.name: Duke Ferdinand Pomp
characters.voice: Languid, drawling, bored. Every sentence an inconvenience.
characters.look: BODY: extremely short and enormously round, wider than he is tall, tiny feet peeking out under a huge round belly, arms too short to reach across the belly. FACE: multiple stacked chins forming a triangle down to his chest, tiny piggy eyes, a small pouting mouth, an oversized powdered white wig with tight rolled curls doubling the width of his head. CLOTHING: a plain fancy waistcoat straining at the buttons.
characters.role: Utterly disconnected from reality. Delightfully so.

characters.name: Clyde Barrelhouse
characters.voice: Fast transatlantic patter, hard consonants, 'see?' tags.
characters.look: BODY: broad-shouldered and barrel-chested, tapering down to comically small feet, one shoulder rolled forward in a permanent swagger. FACE: a heavy square jaw, small close-set eyes shadowed under a low hat brim, a crooked knowing smirk. CLOTHING: a plain pinstripe suit and fedora.
characters.role: Threatens everyone in slang nobody understands.

characters.name: Wilhelmina Frost
characters.voice: Ringing, forceful, oratorical. Builds to a shout every time.
characters.look: BODY: tall with a rigid dignified posture, chin lifted high, one arm permanently raised with a defiant clenched fist. FACE: a fierce determined open-mouthed shout, dark bushy eyebrows drawn together, sharp jawline, tightly-pinned brown hair beneath a wide brimmed hat. CLOTHING: a plain long dark dress with a wide sash.
characters.role: Turns every disagreement into a rally.

characters.name: Cowboy Jed
characters.voice: Slow, dusty drawl. Four words max. Enormous pauses.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a thin, simple, upright silhouette entirely defined by an enormous wide-brimmed hat. FACE: only a single squinted eye-line visible in the deep shadow under the hat brim — the rest of the face stays hidden. PROP: the hat brim itself, nearly as wide as he is tall.
characters.role: Says almost nothing. It's always the right thing.

characters.name: Pharaoh Ozy
characters.voice: Regal, echoing, deeply unimpressed. Sighs like an empire falling.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a small body completely swallowed by an enormous golden pyramid-shaped headdress. FACE: permanently half-lidded bored eyes, chin resting on one propped-up hand. PROP: a crook and flail crossed loosely over his chest, held like he doesn't care.
characters.role: Has seen it all. Nothing impresses him.

characters.name: Brother Cassian
characters.voice: Soft, chanting, gentle. Slips into Latin when stressed.
characters.look: BODY: perfectly round and short, wider than he is tall, hands hidden in enormous drooping sleeves, a huge belly pushing out the front of his robe. FACE: a completely bald tonsured head with only a ring of curly hair around the sides, thick round cheeks, small kind twinkling eyes, a peaceful closed-mouth smile. CLOTHING: a plain brown monk's robe.
characters.role: Documents the chaos in beautiful calligraphy.

characters.name: Captain Mordecai Blackrot
characters.voice: Roaring, ragged, gleeful. Rolls Rs into oblivion.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a wide barrel chest tapering down to a single peg leg, permanently tilted off-balance stance. FACE: one eye completely covered by a huge eyepatch, the other eye comically wide and wild open. PROP: a hook hand raised dramatically in the air.
characters.role: Proposes piracy as the solution to everything.

characters.name: Madame Vespertine
characters.voice: Smoky, theatrical, mysterious — then abruptly transactional.
characters.look: BODY: heavyset and low to the ground, draped in layers that pool around her, permanently leaning forward across an unseen table. FACE: enormous heavily kohl-rimmed eyes, a knowing crooked half-smile, deep laugh lines carved around her mouth. CLOTHING: simple draped shawls and a headwrap.
characters.role: Predicts doom. Charges extra for details.

characters.name: Lore Guy
characters.voice: Fast, breathless, no pauses. Nasal. Escalating complexity.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: hunched forward from the shoulders as if leaning into a lecture, one arm perpetually extended and pointing. FACE: eyes wide with manic over-excitement, mouth caught open mid-sentence. PROP: glasses sliding down to the very tip of his nose.
characters.role: Turns a simple question into a 40-minute deep dive.

characters.name: Doomscroll
characters.voice: Flat, hollow, sleep-deprived. Delivers horrors as small talk.
characters.look: BODY: sunken and curled inward, spine bent into a permanent C-shape, shoulders risen so high they swallow his neck. FACE: hollow dark-ringed eyes lit from below by an unseen screen, slack expressionless mouth, greasy hair hanging over his forehead. CLOTHING: a plain oversized t-shirt.
characters.role: Has read everything. Believes nothing. Feels nothing.

characters.name: NPC Dave
characters.voice: Pleasant, looping, slightly robotic. Repeats his one line.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: deliberately plain average proportions, except one arm frozen mid-swing at a stiff unnatural angle like a repeating animation loop. FACE: a flat, slightly-too-wide smile that never changes, painted-on looking. PROP: none — his repetitive blankness is the whole joke.
characters.role: Slowly realises he isn't the main character.

characters.name: Grindset Gary
characters.voice: Punchy, motivational, mid-workout breathing. Shouts affirmations.
characters.look: BODY: aggressively over-muscled top-heavy torso balanced on comically thin under-developed legs, chest permanently puffed out, arms held wide as if they can't hang straight. FACE: a hard clenched jaw, intense unblinking stare, eyebrows locked down in determination. CLOTHING: a plain tight-fitting t-shirt.
characters.role: Monetises every human experience.

characters.name: Buffer
characters.voice: Stutters, freezes mid-word, catches up in a rush. Pitch warps.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: NOT a human at all — a simple flat circular ring shape, like a donut standing on its edge, frozen mid-roll with no arms or legs, with 2-3 faded semi-transparent duplicate rings trailing behind it like a motion-blur afterimage. FACE: a single frozen half-formed expression painted on the front of the ring, mouth stuck open mid-word. PROP: none — the freeze-frame afterimages are the design.
characters.role: Always a beat behind. Delivers punchlines too late.

characters.name: MegaMod
characters.voice: Nasal, self-important, bureaucratic. Cites rule numbers.
characters.look: BODY: extremely short and pear-shaped, wide at the hips and shoulders drooping forward, permanently leaning back with hands on hips in a self-important stance. FACE: greasy chin-length hair parted in the middle, patchy neckbeard, small glaring self-important eyes behind thick glasses, permanent smug pursed mouth. CLOTHING: a plain black t-shirt stretched over the belly.
characters.role: Bans everyone for imaginary infractions.

characters.name: The Algorithm
characters.voice: Calm, smooth, omnipresent. Slight reverb. Knows what you did.
characters.look: BODY SHAPE: a tall stack of shifting rectangular screen-frames forming a loose humanoid silhouette, no fixed limbs. FACE: no real face — a single brighter glowing rectangle near the top functions as an eye. PROP: none needed.
characters.role: Narrates the video and quietly manipulates it.

characters.name: Boris Hoggard
characters.voice: Deep, gravelly, wheezing between words.
characters.look: BODY: a huge round-bellied humanoid, thick tree-trunk arms folded over a massive gut, standing wide and low. HEAD: a pig head with tusks and a wide flat snout on human shoulders, small mean piggy eyes, floppy pointed pig ears. CLOTHING: a plain rumpled dress shirt with the top buttons open.
characters.role: Cuts every deal in his favor.

characters.name: Vinnie Tuscato
characters.voice: Fast Brooklyn patter, oily and low.
characters.look: BODY: a wiry medium-height humanoid with hunched shoulders, one hand permanently in his suit jacket pocket. HEAD: a long-snouted rat head with pink tail-like whiskers on human shoulders, one drooping ear and one perked, small darting black beady eyes, a long naked pink tail curling out from behind. CLOTHING: a plain dark pinstripe suit.
characters.role: Runs the numbers game in the back alley.

characters.name: Marco Ramline
characters.voice: Slow, punch-drunk mumble.
characters.look: BODY: a tall square-shouldered humanoid with a barrel chest and short thick legs, arms held loose in a permanent defensive stance. HEAD: a ram head with two enormous curled spiraling horns on human shoulders, a broad flat forehead, small squinting eyes, patchy grey wool along the jaw. CLOTHING: a plain sleeveless boxing tank top and shorts.
characters.role: Still thinks he has one more fight in him.

characters.name: Gary Strand
characters.voice: Tired, flat, monotone.
characters.look: BODY: a soft doughy humanoid with a small pot belly and sloping shoulders, standing with hands limp at his sides. HEAD: a bloodhound head with enormous droopy jowls on human shoulders, comically long sagging basset-hound ears hanging past the shoulders, sad heavy-lidded eyes with dark bags, a wet black nose. CLOTHING: a plain wrinkled polo tucked into pleated khakis.
characters.role: Just wants to be left alone.

characters.name: Karla Krest
characters.voice: Shrill, clipped, weaponized politeness.
characters.look: BODY: a medium-height humanoid with hands on hips in a permanent hostile stance, one hip cocked out. HEAD: a cockatoo head on human shoulders, a huge fan of upright yellow feathers exploding from the top of the head like a Karen bob-cut, sharp curved beak, one furious eye. CLOTHING: a plain visor sun-visor and a fitness polo.
characters.role: Wants to speak to the manager.

characters.name: Reggie Kessler
characters.voice: Loud, over-confident, laughs at his own jokes.
characters.look: BODY: a tall humanoid with wide gym-inflated shoulders and skinny legs, one arm perpetually gesturing wide mid-sentence. HEAD: a horse head on human shoulders with a long dopey muzzle, two big square teeth showing in a permanent grin, floppy blond mane brushed back, big goofy eyes. CLOTHING: a plain fitted henley shirt.
characters.role: Has never lost an argument in his own head.

characters.name: Mira Vosk
characters.voice: Slow, precise, hissing S sounds.
characters.look: BODY: a tall thin humanoid standing perfectly upright, arms held clasped at her front, motionless. HEAD: a snake-woman head on human shoulders, smooth green scales instead of skin, unblinking vertical-slit yellow eyes, a thin lipless mouth, a long forked tongue occasionally flicking, no visible nose. CLOTHING: a plain fitted grey business blazer.
characters.role: Reads every contract until she finds the hole.

characters.name: Felix Noire
characters.voice: Smooth, low, purring.
characters.look: BODY: a lean tall humanoid with a permanent lounging slouch, one hand in a pocket. HEAD: a black cat head on human shoulders, half-lidded lazy green eyes, one ear notched from a fight, thin whiskers, a small smug closed-mouth smile, long black tail curling out behind. CLOTHING: a plain dark unbuttoned collar shirt.
characters.role: Knows exactly who owes him.

characters.name: Benji Ford
characters.voice: Fast, high, breathless.
characters.look: BODY: a small compact humanoid, permanently leaning forward as if about to sprint, feet apart, arms slightly out. HEAD: a golden retriever head on human shoulders, huge tongue lolling out of a wide happy open mouth, big glossy eager eyes, floppy golden ears, a bushy wagging tail visible behind. CLOTHING: a plain button-up shirt with a lanyard.
characters.role: Just glad to be here.

characters.name: Olga Brandt
characters.voice: Booming, deep, thick Eastern European.
characters.look: BODY: a towering hulking female humanoid, enormously wide shoulders and thick arms, small waist, standing in a wide stance with fists at her hips. HEAD: a lioness head on human shoulders, a mane of thick tawny fur around a broad flat face, small proud amber eyes, whiskered muzzle, small ears atop the head. CLOTHING: a plain sleeveless leotard and cargo trousers.
characters.role: Can still lift a car if she wants to.

characters.name: Cornelius Blatt
characters.voice: Nasal, wheezy, complaining.
characters.look: BODY: an extremely short and stooped humanoid with a rounded hunched back, arms hanging past his knees, feet turned outward. HEAD: an old bald vulture head on human shoulders, a wrinkled bald pink scalp, a huge sharply curved yellow beak, small greedy black eyes, a droopy neck-wattle. CLOTHING: a plain worn brown waistcoat over a yellowed dress shirt.
characters.role: Won't fix the boiler.

characters.name: Riley Carve
characters.voice: Loud, enthusiastic, always shouting.
characters.look: BODY: a tall lean athletic humanoid in a permanent action stance, arms flexed, one leg forward. HEAD: a shark head on human shoulders, cold flat grey skin, small solid-black doll eyes, a wide open mouth showing rows of triangular teeth in a permanent aggressive grin, small dorsal-fin-shaped hair spike on top. CLOTHING: a plain sleeveless neoprene wetsuit vest.
characters.role: Thinks fear is a choice.
